text:
noah: Heads-up: TelemetryHub just started sending usage archives to our marketplace ingest. Two issues so far: (1) they send a per-device batching TTL that causes overlapping replays, (2) their unit is `nano-credits` which is awkward to reconcile with our `tokens`.
sasha: can you paste a sample payload?
noah: sample (sanitized):
```
partner_id,device_id,batch_start,batch_end,event_id,units,unit_type,ttl_secs,manifest_checksum
TH-88,dev-19,2026-03-21T04:00:00Z,2026-03-21T04:05:00Z,evt-0001,25000,nano-credits,600,sha1:abc123
TH-88,dev-19,2026-03-21T04:03:00Z,2026-03-21T04:08:00Z,evt-0002,18000,nano-credits,600,sha1:def456
```
li: those batches overlap by 2 minutes. If both are replayed we'll double-count the 04:03-04:05 window unless we dedupe by `event_id` or require `manifest_checksum` to be authoritative.
brynn: do they include `external_event_id`? that's our preferred dedupe key across partners.
telemetry-pm: right now we only have `event_id` which is unique per-device but not globally. we can add `external_event_id` and `event_type` (delta vs rollup). TTL is per-device, devices retransmit unack'd batches until TTL expires. working on a fix but may take a firmware cycle.
noah: ingestion team suggestion: dedupe by (partner_id + event_id) and prefer `manifest_checksum` for batch-level acceptance. if batches overlap but checksums differ, mark overlap and run dry-run to surface candidate duplicates to ops.
sasha: unit conversion: TelemetryHub says 1 token = 1e6 nano-credits (fixed). confirmable?
telemetry-pm: yes fixed. we'll send a rate table in the manifest from now on.
li: operationally we should: 
- enforce `external_event_id` presence for any partner replaying >24h of data
- apply 10-minute overlap guard: if two accepted batches overlap by <10m, dedupe at event-level; if >10m, flag for manual review
- convert units at ingest time using partner-supplied rate table and store original units for audit
- allow 48h invoice hold during onboarding + automatic reconciliation against partner manifest (threshold 0.75%)
billing-bot: alert: telemetryhub-ingest job 2026-03-21T04:12Z -> overlap detected between batch BATCH-20260321-04-00 and BATCH-20260321-04-03. ticket #3120 opened.
brynn: can we implement a "manifest-first" ingest mode for TelemetryHub where we only accept batches with a signed manifest. That avoids partial replay woes.
sasha: yes, implement a manifest validator that checks counts and checksum before any row-level mutation. also require `X-Partner-Signature` header on S3 callbacks.
noah: for backfills: 7-day sliding window for late arrivals. require signed manifesto for >24h backfills. we'll compute hourly rollups from the deduped event stream.
telemetry-pm: we'll push a one-off update to include `external_event_id` and a per-batch `manifest.json` for next export (ETA: tomorrow morning).
li: action items:
- telemetry-pm: add `external_event_id`, `event_type`, and include rate table in manifest (ETA 24h)
- sasha: add manifest validator + require `X-Partner-Signature` on callbacks (EOD)
- li: implement 10-minute overlap guard + store original unit fields (2pm PT)
- brynn: draft billing hold + reconciliation threshold doc for TelemetryHub onboarding (tomorrow)
- infra/billing-bot: escalate ticket #3120 if more than 3 overlap events tonight
noah: thanks all. once TelemetryHub confirms manifest fields I'll flip the ingest flag to "manifest-first" for them. :rocket:
